summary: Design and implement a risk appetite framework with KRIs, stress testing, and board-ready reporting. Enrol for practical 5-day training.
lede: Risk appetite framework training helps risk managers, credit analysts, treasury specialists, and governance professionals translate organizational objectives into practical risk limits and monitoring. Participants learn to draft appetite statements, map key risk indicators to thresholds, assess credit and operational exposure, and build escalation workflows and board-level reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you shape risk appetite, monitor risk exposure, or report on governance controls across credit, treasury, operational, or enterprise risk functions. It is also relevant if you support boards, committees, or auditors with clear appetite statements, threshold monitoring, and escalation reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring a working laptop, a current version of Microsoft Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet tool, and familiarity with your organization’s risk reports if available. A basic understanding of risk categories, governance committees, and operational or credit exposure reporting will help you complete the exercises more effectively.
